facts.text: The Tropicale restaurant and bar is housed in the original landmarked Sundial restaurant and bar, now restored.
facts.excerpt: The original landmarked Sundial restaurant and bar, now restored to its original grandeur

facts.text: The Matador Room is the signature restaurant, with a 1940s supper club-like atmosphere and cuisine inspired by South America, the Caribbean and Spain.
facts.excerpt: Featuring a supper club-like atmosphere reminiscent of the 1940s, the Matador Room tempts guests with innovative cuisine inspired by the flavors of South America, the Caribbean, and Spain.

facts.text: The Matador Room was developed by Michelin-starred Chef Jean-Georges Vongerichten.
facts.excerpt: Developed by Michelin-starred Chef Jean-Georges Vongerichten

facts.text: The hotel has a four-lane bowling alley, Basement Bowl, with color-changing lighting effects.
facts.excerpt: Basement Bowl is a four-lane bowling alley with visually spectacular lighting effects of dramatic, color-changing illuminations.

facts.text: The hotel has a 2,000 square-foot indoor ice skating rink.
facts.excerpt: One of the most intriguing features at The Miami Beach EDITION is the 2,000 square-foot indoor ice skating rink.

facts.text: Basement Bowl and Basement Skate enforce a 21+ rule after 9PM.
The Lobby Bar has original gold and marble columns and a 1950s Miami Beach feel.
facts.excerpt: The glamour of 1950s Miami Beach can be found in every detail of the Lobby Bar, from the original gold and marble columns to the Latin-inspired soundtrack.

facts.text: Market at EDITION is a food hall-inspired restaurant with a dining room overlooking Collins Avenue.
facts.excerpt: Market at EDITION, a food hall-inspired restaurant in the heart of Miami Beach.

facts.text: The hotel includes bungalows, and top-level bungalows have a roof deck with a private plunge pool.
facts.excerpt: Top-level bungalows include a roof deck with a private plunge pool.

facts.text: Rooms are pet-friendly, with marble bathrooms and enclosed rainforest showers.
facts.excerpt: Pet-friendly hotel rooms benefit from spacious layouts, marble bathrooms with enclosed rainforest showers, and fine linens.

facts.text: The hotel has two outdoor ocean-facing pools.
The Spa at The Miami Beach EDITION offers massages, beauty treatments and lap pool sessions.
facts.excerpt: including massages, beauty treatments, and lap pool sessions

facts.text: The hotel is on Collins Avenue in Miami Beach.
Matador Bar has black walnut-paneled walls with photographs from Lucien Clergue's Matador series.
facts.excerpt: American black walnut-paneled walls with photographs from renowned French photographer Lucien Clergue
